flow.title: Note → reviewed write-back
flow.summary: Update an existing note safely: capture the base state, then propose the edit through review with a concurrency check.

steps.owned_job: Capture the current base state of the note being edited.
steps.instruction: Fetch the existing note and record its base_state_id so the later proposal can detect concurrent edits.
steps.trigger: Run when an update to an existing note is ready to be written.
steps.when_not_to_run: Skip if note_path does not resolve, or the note is out of the actor's writable scope.
boundaries: Read only — do not mutate the note here
steps.output_shape: The note's current base_state_id plus its existing body, ready for an edit proposal.

verification.description: A base_state_id for the target note is captured and recorded.

steps.owned_job: Propose the edit through review with a concurrency check.
steps.instruction: Submit the updated content as a Knowtation proposal pinned to the captured base_state_id for human approval.
steps.trigger: Run after the base state is captured and the updated content is ready.
steps.when_not_to_run: Skip if base_state_id is missing, or the note changed underneath since it was captured.
boundaries: Never write canonical knowledge directly — route through the proposal/review tray
Always pin base_state_id so concurrent edits are detected
No secrets in the proposal body or provenance
steps.output_shape: A pending proposal id pinned to the captured base_state_id.

verification.description: Reviewer approves the edit via the review tray and the base_state_id concurrency check passes; approval id recorded.
